retry_policy.description: One scientific final-test exposure. An ordinary second run is forbidden after success. A genuine technical crash after access consumption permits only an exact continuation/resume of the SAME frozen run, and only if the governance framework can prove identical run identity, code commit, configuration, and artifact hashes, with preserved access history and no science-affecting change. A reset is never performed merely because metrics are undesirable, and the bootstrap seed/B, slices, model, calibrator, and threshold are never changed post-access. If safe exact-resume cannot be proven, the run fails closed and all evidence is preserved.
